name: SubwayLens
tagline: Live train arrivals on your glasses
description: Real-time train arrivals on Even Realities G2 smart glasses. NYC subway, LIRR and Metro-North departure boards with track numbers, plus BART, MBTA, SEPTA Regional Rail, Denver RTD, MARTA, and Minneapolis METRO. Scroll between favorited stations and never miss a train again.
author: SubwayLens

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Access real-time transit data feeds (MTA, BART, MBTA, SEPTA, RTD, MARTA, Metro Transit) to display live train arrival times

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Find nearby stations when 'Show nearby stations' is enabled in settings
